en: The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest
orig: The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest
plotEn:
For centuries, Vvaan Devi has protected a village, where entering the forest after sunset is strictly forbidden. Legend says that anyone who witnesses what happens in the darkness becomes prey to the Goddess’s tiger.
During Chhath Puja, Rishi, his wife Mamta, and their friend VP return to the village. When plans to develop the sacred forest spark a family dispute, Rishi defies tradition by entering it after dark. But when his nephew Phinish and VP venture into the forest to uncover its secrets, chaos engulfs the village, forcing Rishi to risk everything to save them.
